request.objective: Project OS BUILD for JobBot CHG-200-r2 on exact integrated main 5a55d9f6328c4dd5a36292eb938ef2cd1400ff07: add Bright Data Jobs Scraper API as first production-candidate managed adapter behind CHG-200-r1 acquisition-v2, build/test only.

adapter.name: brightdata-jobs
adapter.contract: ProviderAdapter.fetch(SearchTask) -> ProviderBatch through acquisition-v2 coordinator and shared identity-first ingestion
adapter.dataset_ids_and_field_names: runtime-configurable per platform; no account-specific IDs or schemas are hard-coded
adapter.offline_preflight: presence and JSON/schema validity only; token validity is explicitly not checked; no network or ledger access

task_mapping.request_fields: keyword is required; optional location, remote and window fields are emitted only when explicitly configured by that platform schema
task_mapping.home_only_intent: configured home_state/home_metro and remote intent are request filters only; unsupported filters are omitted and no eligibility evidence is fabricated

mock_schema_coverage.linkedin: configured keyword, home_state location, remote literal and integer freshness mapping
mock_schema_coverage.indeed: configured keyword, home_metro location and freshness template mapping

task_mapping.schema_note: Field names above describe mocked test configurations only, not Bright Data account defaults.

sanitized_request_contract.trigger: POST /datasets/v3/trigger; configured dataset_id, documented type=discover_new and discover_by=keyword, include_errors=true, format=json, limit_multiple_results=remaining budget; body contains only configured keyword/filter fields
sanitized_request_contract.results: GET /datasets/v3/snapshot/{snapshot_id} for every reported part using JSON, batch_size and part
sanitized_request_contract.metadata: Exact sanitized trigger/progress/parts/result request shape and canonical SHA-256 request fingerprint; no Authorization header or token
sanitized_request_contract.field_policy: Normalize only explicitly mapped observed fields; preserve sanitized raw rows; ignore provider verification claims. Missing values remain unknown.

lifecycle_and_completion.completion_rule: COMPLETE only after terminal ready, valid part count, every part retrieved and parsed, no provider error rows, malformed identity rows, continuation markers, missing parts or budget cap, plus explicit completion evidence
completion_evidence_fields: part totals and retrieved part numbers
lifecycle_and_completion.failure_classes: authorization, configuration, schema, transport, timeout, ambiguous cursor, partial batch, invalid response and unknown are recorded without exhausting incomplete tasks
lifecycle_and_completion.retry_bounds: provider-local bounded transient retries and polling; no legacy Chrome fallback

budget_and_accounting.cli: --max-records is a required positive explicit validation budget with --provider brightdata-jobs; live transport also requires --live-transport
budget_and_accounting.budget_effect: sent through documented total-result limit; exact-cap tasks remain incomplete; once exhausted, remaining planned tasks are checkpointed incomplete without more provider calls
budget_and_accounting.cost_policy: no estimated charges; secret echoes in provider row/cost values are rejected or redacted before persistence

diagnostics.chg114_ordering: learned-order dimensions and frozen execution ranks are unchanged

full_python_suite.skip_reason: Historical-ledger migration fixture skipped because sanitized copy intentionally excludes local data/jobs.sqlite3.
full_python_suite.execution: sanitized disposable project copy with disposable default data/out paths; production data directory excluded; Bright Data token/config environment variables removed

tests.browser_runtime: NOT_RUN; no Chrome or Big-3 browser runtime
invariant_regressions: CHG-200-r1 provider-neutral seam/shared ingestion/browser RPC compatibility
CHG-170 frozen 140-task universe and 21 deep pairs
mixed card/detail identity-before-detail, repeated snapshot dedupe, distinct requisitions, and validation-budget incomplete checkpointing

safety_boundary.production_approval: NOT APPROVED; separate live qualification and production selection required

product_reference_review.notes: The Jobs Scraper page currently advertises a 5,000-record monthly free tier and pay only for successfully delivered results. Product coverage, pricing and account-specific terms may change and must be reverified during live qualification; plan any qualification within the then-current verified free-tier balance. Marketing is not treated as API contract.
